content:
**Spruce Knob Channels** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia.

Featuring a few islands between the ponds and canals near Spruce Knob Lake and R&G Station, this somewhat secluded area is less accessible due to the natural barriers it provides. Despite their proximity, the channels do not connect to Spruce Knob Lake.

There is an abundance of edible plants and a few metal ore deposits (Iron, Copper, and Lead), along with plenty of Wood Scraps and water. Three dug-in Floaters (one of each variant) can be spotted at this location.

Spruce Knob Channels appears in *Fallout 76*.
